bullets: On Monday 2 November, DLD recorded 822 sales worth AED 2.1bn, up 10.2% on a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 58.9% of the total on Monday, compared to 56.3% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,721 per sqft, up 3.3% from the 30-day average and down 3.7% from last year.
Over the last 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 239 sales, Liwan1 with 185 sales, and Dubai South with 150 sales.
In October new rental contracts for 1BR apartments in JVC had a median of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Clients who graduated from a university abroad could qualify for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa, so check the details before advising.
Dubai South housing is seeing a boom with studios dominating and rents more than doubling as home sales beat the 2025 record in just 8 months.
Brent oil recently slid to $93 and $94 due to Iran uncertainty after US midterms, which can move investor sentiment.

items.headline: Top University Graduates Qualify for UAE Golden Visa
items.summary: Alumni from the world's leading 100 universities are now eligible for a 10-year residency in the UAE. This pathway encourages top global talent to settle long-term.
items.why: It attracts skilled professionals who may become long-term property investors.
items.impact_reason: Expands residency eligibility for potential buyers.

items.headline: Foreign University Graduates Eligible for UAE Golden Visa
items.summary: Graduates from international universities can secure a 10-year UAE residency. The initiative welcomes skilled global talent into the country.
items.why: It opens new residency options for international professionals looking to relocate.
items.impact_reason: Broadens the pool of potential long-term residents.

items.headline: Dubai South Housing Demand Surges Past Previous Records
items.summary: Studio apartments are leading a massive housing boom in Dubai South. Rental prices have more than doubled as sales surpassed annual records in just eight months.
items.why: It highlights rapid growth and high rental yields in a key emerging district.
items.impact_reason: Shows strong investor demand and rising rents.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi Property Sales Surge 30 Percent in October
items.summary: Property transactions in Abu Dhabi reached AED 13 billion during October. Buyer demand remains notably robust across the capital.
items.why: It signals strong market momentum and high investor confidence in Abu Dhabi.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi Residential Sales Reach AED 12.97 Billion in October
items.summary: Residential unit sales in Abu Dhabi increased by over 30 percent in October 2026. Total transactional value neared the 13 billion dirham mark.
items.why: It provides concrete data on capital market performance and liquidity.

items.headline: Brent Oil Slides to 94 Dollars Amid Political Shifts
items.summary: Global oil benchmarks dropped to near two-month lows following political updates in the US and geopolitical uncertainty surrounding Iran. Market sentiment reacted quickly to the changing political landscape.
items.why: Oil price movements influence overall economic sentiment and liquidity in the region.

items.headline: Understanding Dubai Escrow Accounts for Off-Plan Buyers
items.summary: Dubai's escrow system ensures that funds paid by purchasers for off-plan properties remain legally protected. This regulatory framework safeguards buyer investments throughout construction.
items.why: It reassures buyers regarding the safety of their investments in uncompleted projects.
items.impact_reason: Reinforces buyer confidence in off-plan purchases.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi Golden Visa Criteria for Top University Graduates
items.summary: The emirate outlines specific entry criteria for graduates from top global universities seeking a Golden Visa. The program targets high-achieving individuals from around the world.
items.why: It clarifies the requirements for foreign graduates seeking long-term stability.

items.headline: Sharjah Court Clears Villa Co-Owner in Rental Fraud Case
items.summary: A Sharjah court acquitted a villa co-owner involved in a rental fraud dispute. The case centered around an amount of AED 104,000.
items.why: This is a legal dispute and court verdict rather than a market-moving real estate trend.
items.impact_reason: Single court case with no broader market impact.

items.headline: Asset Homez Honoured as Top-Performing Broker by Alef Group
items.summary: Alef Group recognized Asset Homez for their strong performance in the local property sector. This marks another milestone for the brokerage in the UAE market.
items.why: This is a corporate award and PR announcement rather than actionable market news.
items.impact_reason: Company award with no effect on buyers or investors.

items.headline: Dubai Introduces New Rent Now Pay Later Option for Tenants
items.summary: Dubai has introduced a fresh financing service allowing tenants to defer rent payments. This initiative aims to ease rental payment burdens across the emirate.
items.why: Flexible payment schemes directly impact tenant cash flow and rental affordability.
items.impact_reason: Improves tenant liquidity and alters rental payment methods.

items.headline: DECA Unveils Lorévia Collection and Announces Dh3B Development Pipeline
items.summary: DECA Developments revealed its new residential collection and waterfront address during a major event in Dubai. The firm also outlined an ambitious expansion strategy worth Dh3 billion.
items.why: New project launches and developer pipelines directly expand residential supply options.
items.impact_reason: Adds new residential supply and highlights developer expansion.

items.headline: Geopolitical Tensions Rise as Brent Oil Drops to $93
items.summary: Regional security developments involve reported tanker incidents near Qatar amid international mediation efforts. Meanwhile, global Brent oil prices have declined to $93.
items.why: Macroeconomic shifts and regional security can influence investor sentiment and market stability.
items.impact_reason: Macro events and oil price shifts affect investor sentiment.

items.headline: How Syrian Expat Built fäm Properties Into a Giant
items.summary: An editorial profile details the journey of Firas Al Msaddi in growing fäm Properties. It outlines the path to becoming a major brokerage in Dubai.
items.why: This is an executive profile piece lacking direct news value for property transactions.
items.impact_reason: Personality profile with no direct impact on market conditions.

items.headline: Meraas Showcases Dubai Design Week 2026 Installations
items.summary: Meraas is presenting future concepts for the design district during Dubai Design Week 2026. The showcase highlights creative urban planning initiatives.
items.why: Design exhibitions and cultural events do not constitute direct property market news.
items.impact_reason: Design exhibition with no direct bearing on property transactions.

items.headline: Dubai Tenant Faces Eviction Over Unpaid Commercial Rent
items.summary: A commercial tenant in Dubai is facing eviction due to unpaid rent totaling Dh2.4 million. Legal actions are proceeding regarding the outstanding balance.
items.why: Commercial lease defaults and eviction disputes reflect ongoing landlord-tenant legal enforcement.
items.impact_reason: Individual legal dispute without systemic market consequences.
